subject: ACME MAP: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: ACME MAP: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps

Hi Sarah -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed MAP so we have alignment on scope, stakeholders, decision process, and dates. Please feel free to edit or add items.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current response times for customer-facing features spike during daily afternoon peak; latency-sensitive workflows (search & summarization) are suffering.
- Cost per inference for batch jobs is growing; finance needs clear unit economics for scale.
- Security/compliance: data residency and audit logs required for Q4 procurement.

Goals we agreed on:
- 30% reduction in p50/p95 latency for peak workloads within pilot window.
- 20% reduction in per-token inference cost via batching/quantization suggestions.
- Complete compliance evidence (SOC2-like docs, KMS integration notes) for procurement review.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
1) Pilot kickoff & environment access - owners: ACME eng (Sarah, Raj), Redwood eng (Dev) - Target: Oct 20, 2026 - Deliverable: test harness + sample dataset access
2) Performance baseline & tuning - owners: Redwood infra (Dylan), ACME eng - Target: Oct 28, 2026 - Deliverable: latency/cost baseline report
3) Security & compliance review - owners: Redwood security (Marissa), ACME security/procurement - Target: Nov 3, 2026 - Deliverable: security pack + SOC2 evidence packet
4) Exec review & procurement sign-off - owners: ACME procurement (Procurement team), Redwood sales - Target: Nov 12, 2026 - Deliverable: SOW and pricing proposal

Open questions / dependencies:
- Which environment should we use for the pilot (ACME VPC vs Redwood hosted sandbox)? Please confirm by EOD Wed Oct 14.
- Any sample PII in the dataset? If so, we'll share a handling plan and need the data owner identified.

Attachments: I'm attaching a one-page MAP (acme-redwood-map-v1.pdf) and our security pack summary (redwood-security-pack.pdf).

Next steps I'll take:
- Share onboarding checklist and invite the pilot kick-off meeting for Oct 20 (tentative)
- Draft SOW stub for pricing discussion

Next steps for ACME:
- Confirm pilot environment preference and dataset owner
- Share procurement timeline and any mandatory contract terms

Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: ACME MAP: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps

Marissa -

Thanks for the thorough recap - this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Pilot environment: we'd prefer the ACME VPC option for the pilot if possible. Security will want to see the KMS/HSM integration details, but we can start with a subset of traffic routed through the hosted sandbox if timing is tight.

2) Dataset: the initial sample includes customer support transcripts. There is minimal PII, but we'll anonymize names before sharing. I'll loop in Raj (eng) to confirm the anonymization timeline.

3) Procurement timeline: we're aiming for an exec review by Nov 10, procurement sign-off by Nov 18. Procurement has requested an initial pricing stub and SOW to review during the exec meeting.

Can you include estimated pricing bands for the pilot and for a 12-month committed Dedicated capacity option in the SOW stub? That will help procurement prep.

I've added Raj on the thread to surface engineering constraints.

Best,
Sarah
Director of Product Operations | ACME Corp
sarah.thompson@acme.com

Couple of updates based on your notes:

- Raj - thanks - when you have the anonymized dataset timeline, drop it here and we'll plan the pilot data ingestion window.
- Procurement ask: I've attached a SOW stub with two pricing bands (pilot and 12-month dedicated) for procurement to review before the exec meeting. See the link below to the HubSpot deal and the DocuSign stub for SOW signature when ready.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Marissa (Redwood): send SOW stub & invite for Oct 20 pilot kickoff - by Oct 14 (DONE) - SOW link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-12345
- Dev/Dylan (Redwood): VPC/KMS checklist - by Oct 16

- ACME Procurement: review pricing bands and provide feedback - by Oct 30

I'll keep this thread updated as we hit milestones. If anything changes to the dates, flag it here and we'll adjust.
